vol-convexity.invalidation: The flat stance changes if a quoted FX option premium and implied vol appear on EURUSD, USDJPY, or AUDUSD that can be marked against this realized tape.
vol-convexity.thesis: EURUSD realized volatility near 5.7 sits at the bottom of its 20-day range after spot broke down through 1.1127, so the break and the vol compression disagree. USDJPY's upside break at 159.23 leaves a linear long wearing gap risk, and AUDUSD is in the same kind of breakdown at 0.6859. Equity VIX at 19.46 does not price any of those FX paths. The expression that fits is owned convexity, and the freeze has no listed FX option premium or implied vol to mark, so the book stays flat.
